full_judgment: 12. A suit for declaration simpliciter in a case, such as the present one, is maintainable without any further or consequential relief by way of recovery of khas possession, since the mutation order was challenged as made in excess of jurisdiction in the interest of maintenance or preservation of legal and proper act namely, the preparation of SA record.
